title: Count missed deadlines
prompt: Compare completion times with matching deadlines. A completion exactly at its deadline is on time. Return the number with completion > deadline. Both vectors contain nonnegative integer times. Throw std::invalid_argument if their lengths differ.
signature: std::size_t deadlineMisses(const std::vector<int>& completed, const std::vector<int>& deadlines)
hints: Check equal sizes before the loop.
Use > rather than >= for the late test.
explanation: This checks recorded timing data. It models deadline accounting and makes no claim about real-time scheduling guarantees of the machine running it.
